full_judgment: 20. He also read the statements made in paragraph No. 6(c) and (h) of the affidavit-in-opposition that a few directors attended the meeting; that 60.6 share-holders were not notified; that ex facie there was no quorum as per article 39; that representation on behalf of Kranti Associates Ltd. was also not represented as per provision of Section 86 of the Act; that two different versions of the minutes one signed by the Chairman and the other by the Managing Director were submitted to the Registrar, defendant No. 5 and the Registrar by his letter dated 10.05.99 asked for an explanation from the Managing Director, defendant No. 1 who did not comply with the request. He submitted that the statements should be taken as correct since the petitioners did not controvert any of them. No book containing any minutes could also be produced. In the circumstances, when the contrary was proved that there was no valid EGM was called and held there was no scope for any presumption under Section 89(3) of the Act.
